samples.animation:
x = 40
speed = 8

def setup():
    canvas(400, 400)
    background(255)
    no_stroke()

def draw(frame):
    global x, speed
    x += speed

    if x > 360:
        x = 720 - x
        speed = -speed
    elif x < 40:
        x = 80 - x
        speed = -speed

    background(255)
    fill(30, 120, 255)
    circle(x, 200, 40)
